summary: LUOGU plays Peking opera percussion patterns and jinghu interludes, for learning the percussion by playing along or for singing an aria with a backing band. Docs in English and Chinese.
features: 64 luogu jing percussion patterns with syllables lit as they sound
Play-along mode drops your instrument's part and scores timing
18 banshi and five whole arias with jinghu, jingerhu and yueqin
Follow-along practice waits for each stroke before moving on
Recorded percussion strokes; synthesised gong and fiddles
USB MIDI keyboard or pad plays like the built-in keys
